title: Customer Care Re-Contact Schedule: Cleaning and Damage Fees Level-Difference Refunds
content:
**Clause 1.** The re-contact goodwill of a Cleaning and Damage Fees level-difference refund is read from the calendar days since the assessment's dispute was closed: more than the re-contact days take the long re-contact goodwill; the re-contact days or fewer take the short re-contact goodwill; a dispute not yet closed, or no dispute, takes no re-contact goodwill.

| Calendar days from the assessment's closed date to the refund date | Re-contact goodwill |
|---|---|
| more than 30 | $10.00 (long re-contact) |
| 30 or fewer | $5.00 (short re-contact) |
| no closed date (dispute not yet closed, or no dispute) | none |

**Clause 2.** The closed date is the one on the assessment record, and the days are counted to the date of the refund.

**Clause 3.** The re-contact goodwill is a fixed amount added to the level-difference refund; the total refund is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.

## Boundary days (hypothetical; dispute closed on 1 June)

| Refund date | Days since the dispute was closed | Re-contact goodwill |
|---|---|---|
| 1 June | 0 | $5.00 |
| 1 July | 30 | $5.00 |
| 2 July | 31 | $10.00 |
